keyEvents.text: Lucas Martínez Quarta (River Plate) is shown the red card.
Substitution, River Plate. Lautaro Rivero replaces Lucas Beltrán.
Lautaro Di Lollo (Boca Juniors) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Boca Juniors 1, River Plate 0. Lautaro Di Lollo (Boca Juniors) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sebastián Villa with a cross following a corner.
Facundo Herrera (Boca Juniors) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Marcos Acuña (River Plate) is shown the yellow card.
Leandro Paredes (Boca Juniors) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Boca Juniors. Ayrton Costa replaces Facundo Herrera.
Substitution, River Plate. Lautaro Pereyra replaces Lucas Silva.
Second Half begins Boca Juniors 1, River Plate 0.
